context: Tests assets directory convention, canonical tags and handling a missing companion CLI.

checklist.name: Loaded the learning schema
checklist.description: The agent reads learning.yaml in full before generating.

checklist.name: Assets in an entry-specific sibling directory
checklist.description: The screenshots go to `2026-04-11-<slug>/assets/` next to the entry, not a shared month-level folder.

checklist.name: Relative image paths
checklist.description: The entry references images as `![alt](2026-04-11-<slug>/assets/01-alarm-list.png)` or equivalent relative paths.

checklist.name: Images have alt text
checklist.description: Each image has non-empty alt text.

checklist.name: Checked git ignore rules for assets
checklist.description: The agent checks the project's `.gitignore` before assuming the assets are tracked or ignored.

checklist.name: Used canonical tags
checklist.description: Tags come from the taxonomy facets, such as `aws-cloudwatch`, rather than near-duplicates.

checklist.name: Collapsed aliases
checklist.description: Any non-canonical spelling (for example `teams`) is replaced with its canonical form (`ms-teams`).

checklist.name: Confirmed the binary before the CLI step
Skipped the CLI-backed step when missing
checklist.description: When the binary is missing, the agent skips the corpus lint, says so, and still completes the self-contained workflow.

checklist.name: Validated the entry with the bundled script
checklist.description: The agent runs `validate-journal-entry.sh` on the entry.
